description: Published September moisture rule, Lin et al. 2025 (Agronomy 15(6):1438, TempDiff-SMID, Hohhot): silage if September LSWI <= 0.15, else grain. LSWI = repo ndmi (B8A, B11). Literal port fixed before evaluation: rule = median of clear (valid_frac >= 0.5) Sentinel-2 looks dated 1-30 September <= 0.15; NaN when the field-year has no clear September look. Features: that median and the September minimum. Calendar-bound by design: the paper's thresholds were re-tuned by hand each year and one harvest calendar does not transfer across regions.

rule_definition.statistic: median of clear September ndmi looks
